subject: error reading CRAM file with featureCounts

messages.author: 8185119e74435d89
messages.subject: error reading CRAM file with featureCounts
parts: When I try to provide a CRAM file (e.g. testfile.cram) as input to featureCounts, it gives the error "invalid parameter: 'testfile.cram'". If I use samtools to convert the same file to SAM or BAM format, it works normally. Is featureCounts unable to read CRAM files?

messages.author: bce99ba71cd48eea
messages.subject: Re: error reading CRAM file with featureCounts
parts:
No, featureCounts in its current version doesn't support CRAM-format input files.  It can only read SAM or BAM files as read mapping results.

You may need to convert the CRAM files into SAM/BAM files before running featureCounts.

messages.author: 8185119e74435d89
messages.subject: Re: error reading CRAM file with featureCounts
parts: Thanks for the quick reply. Is CRAM support under active development?
